scientific_integrity: One theorem, exact assumptions and a direct proof. Nonequivariant homotopy classification of Deshpande and Singh is acknowledged as pre-existing. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary geometric orbit space for the full partwise permutation group only; no arbitrary-subgroup or Borel quotient. Infinite theorem proved directly; finite tests supplementary. Bibliographic priority subject to inaccessible full text of arXiv:2607.05358.
title: Partwise-symmetric orbit spaces of higher independence complexes
